description: Build an unsigned, simulated swap transaction for the user's own Stellar account, ready to sign. Returns the XDR, the expected and minimum amounts, the network fee, warnings, and sign links: sign.web opens a skyhitz.io page where the user signs with their own wallet and the swap is submitted; sign.sep7 is a SEP-7 link for wallets that support it. Nothing moves until the user signs. Show the user the amounts and warnings first.

account.description: The user's account: it pays, signs and (unless to is set) receives.

amount.description: Exact amount of sell to trade.

buy.description: HITZ, XLM, USDC (any case), or a token contract address (C…).

sell.description: HITZ, XLM, USDC (any case), or a token contract address (C…).

slippage_bps.description: How far below the quote the output may land, in basis points (100 = 1%).

to.description: Optional recipient (G… or C…) instead of account.

name: build_swap
title: Build a swap transaction
